$Comment: Supplies the Loot block that the pack's Stations/Sawmill.json full-file override used to carry, now that the jar's own Sawmill.json (RPG Stations) stays live and this pack no longer overrides the whole station. The jar's own Lootables/SawmillFinds.json rolls (a BasePercent 2 tool_power-scaled bonus-copy Chance capped 25 percent, plus a Conditions-gated cycle_count Ladder to the jar's own small RPG_Station_Sawmill_T1/T2 drop lists) fire additively alongside whatever this pack adds via Extensions/SawmillProgression.json's Loot ref; the two bonus-copy rolls scale off different axes (tool power vs MMO luck) and are both intended to fire, so a better hatchet and a luckier woodcutter each earn their own independent extra plank. The luck-tier ladder is the one true carryover from the pack's retired Sawmill.json: its three floor values (50/100/150) are kept byte-identical, and its trigger factor is Ladder.Values (a weighted FactorRef array) summing stat/MMO_Luck + stat/MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING (equal Weight 1.0 each) instead of the single aggregate mmoskilltree:station_luck; station_luck is a true-equivalence aggregate of exactly this factor set, so the composition is numerically equivalent to the old single-factor ladder and needed no floor renumbering. The jar's own small secondary ladder (cycle_count-gated, 15 percent chance, capped at its own T2 tier) is a bounded, minor additional stack this pack does not edit (RPG Stations jar content is not owned here). DropList ids referenced below (MMO_Station_Sawmill_T1/T2/T3) are this pack's own native ItemDropList assets (Server/Drops/), distinct from the jar's RPG_Station_Sawmill_T1/T2; no id collision.
